name: editMessageWidgetData

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Required if inline_message_id is not specified. Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup in the format @username.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Required if inline_message_id is not specified. Identifier of the message with the widget.

parameters.name: inline_message_id
parameters.description: Required if chat_id and message_id are not specified. Identifier of the inline message.

parameters.name: public_data
parameters.description: New public data of the widget, 0-1024 bytes; pass an empty string to remove the public data. If omitted, then the public data isn't changed.

parameters.name: chat_data
parameters.description: New data of the widget, which is specific to the message, 0-1024 bytes; pass an empty string to remove the data. If omitted, then the data isn't changed.

description: Use this method to edit data of a widget in a message sent by the bot or via the bot (for inline bots). Public data of a shared widget can be changed at most once per second. On success, True is returned.
